Anya (Product): Quick async: Q2 milestone sync — please drop a 1-line for what shipped, what slipped, owner, next steps. Flag any CRs blocking ship.

Sam (Eng): Shipped: Console telemetry v2 (routes, token breakdown). Owner: Sam. Next: propagate to dashboards by EOW. CR: @Priya please review #453

Priya (Eng): Looking now, aim for review by today 3pm PT. small nit on metrics tag

Li (Eng-Platform): Slipped: model-routing v2 — kernel perf regression after A100 driver update. Owner: Li. Impact: p99 latency misses on heavy tail. Next: roll back driver + perf rerun. ETA for rollback: tomorrow morning. @Talia FYI for customer comms

Talia (Eng Manager): Thanks. I'll craft a short note for impacted customers and add to console incident feed.

Mateo (SRE): Can we tag the canary? I want logs: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l canary=true`

Sam (Eng): tagging canary now, see snippet:
```
./scripts/canary-tag.sh inference-route model-routing-v2-canary
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for model-routing-v2 failed (healthcheck 503) — auto-rolled back

Li (Eng-Platform): Confirmed rollback done. Perf tests queued. Will update with numbers here.

Anya (Product): Awesome, thanks all. One more: CR backlog — Priya, Sam, can you coordinate on #453 and #461? If either blocks next release, mark as high-priority in PR.

Priya (Eng): Will prioritize #453 today. For #461 need Alex's final sign-off (added as reviewer).

Alex (Eng): Added review. aiming EOD.

Talia (Eng Manager): Owners summary for OKR doc:
- Shipped: Console telemetry v2 — Sam
- Slipped: Model-routing v2 — Li (rollback in progress)
- Blockers: CR #461 waiting on Alex
Next steps: customer note, perf rerun, CRs prioritized. I'll drop this into the OKR doc by noon PST.

Anya (Product): Thanks team — if anything changes, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
